pages.title: About - ABG Project Finance
pages.main_text_excerpt:
ABG Project Finance was founded by six professional partners, all with extensive experience from top tier companies within the real estate market.
As of 1 January 2026 ABG Sundal Collier has integrated ABG Project Finance into its Investment Banking organisation, further strengthening its Real Estate and Construction platform across the Nordic region. The integration brings together complementary expertise in project finance, capital markets, and strategic advisory, creating a more unified and agile platform for clients.
For more information, please contact Fredrik Melfald (fredrik.melfald@abgpf.com)

pages.title: Team - ABG Project Finance
pages.main_text_excerpt:
ABG Business Management
ABG Business Management (previously Vika Business Management) was established in June 2018. The company is a subsidiary of ABG Project Finance and is managed by Torgeir Dale. The company provides corporate management, advisory and accounting services to investments and project companies originated by ABG Project Finance.
ABG Real Estate Management
ABG Real Estate Management (previously Vika Asset Management) was established in 2021. The company is a subsidiary of ABG Project Finance and is managed by Jonas Jevanord. The company is responsible for monitoring property performance and maximizing property revenue in the ABG Project Finance portfolio.
